incident.error: Stage APPLY_SITE_ENTITLEMENTS failed: Kit «marketing_automation» cannot be licensed to a site.
incident.message_source: ApplySiteEntitlementsStage, when ModuleLicenseGrantService::grant() returns INVALID_MODULE (module not assignable or type !== paid)
incident.root_cause: SiteOnboardingService::kits() offered every license-only module as a kit. On production that is 56 modules: 3 paid (motion-graphics-premium 61, solar_calculator 62, solar_industry_kit 63) and 53 core platform modules with license_required = true (captcha, blog, marketing_automation, ...). grant() licenses only paid modules, and no path licenses a core one (0 core module_licenses on production). The admin ticked all 56 (installations 49, 50 and 53 carry them, in different orders). The stage granted the leading real kits and failed on the first core one (marketing_automation, id 32, third in submission order).
incident.solar_profile: The solar_energy profile preselects only kit 63 (solar_industry_kit), which requires vertical solar_energy.
incident.other_kits_checked: 61, 62 and 63 are paid, license-only and active, with no published code package, so enableForSite() activates them directly in site_modules (no module deployment dispatch); none can fail grant().
